title: Sensex falls about 460 pts, Nifty ends near 22,688; third straight loss as oil, West Asia weigh
dek: IT, FMCG and autos lagged; M&M Financial sank nearly 10% after results while Indian Hotels rose. Exact closing figures follow in tonight's report.
body: Indian shares fell for a third session on Thursday. Business Standard's closing update reported the Sensex down about 460 points and the Nifty 50 ending near 22,688, roughly 0.5% below Wednesday's close of 22,811.35. These are preliminary figures from the closing headline; tonight's daily report will give the exact closing levels, day range and breadth.

The pressure came from oil and West Asia: tension around Iran and attacks on ships near the Strait of Hormuz kept Brent near $108–110 a barrel. IT, FMCG and auto shares underperformed, and Lupin, SRF, Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles, Maruti Suzuki and NTPC touched 52-week lows during the day. Silver ETFs fell nearly 3% on bets of another US rate hike.

Results drove individual stocks. Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services fell 9.82% to ₹268.25 after its numbers, while Indian Hotels rose 4.7% to ₹788.75 after a 22.6% rise in quarterly profit to ₹350 crore. eMudhra hit a 20% lower circuit, the maximum fall allowed in a day, for a second straight session. Jio's IPO reached 4.3 times subscription by 2:12 pm, with retail at 1.39 times.
Key takeaway: three losing days in a row show the market is cautious while oil stays near $110; HPCL, Havells, Swiggy and Colgate results after the close are the next triggers.
indiaImpact: Oil near $110 keeps pressure on the rupee, inflation and oil-using sectors such as autos and chemicals; results season is making individual stock moves much bigger than the index moves.

piggy.happened: The Sensex fell about 460 points and the Nifty ended near 22,688 (preliminary), its third straight fall, with IT, FMCG and autos weakest.
piggy.matters: A 'lower circuit' like eMudhra's means the stock fell the maximum the exchange allows in one day, so sellers could not find buyers below that price.
